title: Offspring
description: Defines the way an entity can create a born offspring.

blend_attributes.title: Blend Attributes
blend_attributes.description: If true, the entities will blend their attributes in the offspring after they breed.

deny_parents_variant.title: Deny Parents Variant
deny_parents_variant.description:
Determines how likely the baby of parents with the same variant will deny that variant and take a random variant within the given range instead.

Properties:
• chance (float) = 0
• max_variant (int) = 0
• min_variant (int) = 0

chance.title: Chance
chance.description: The percentage chance of denying the parents' variant.

max_variant.title: Max Variant
max_variant.description: The inclusive maximum of the variant range.

min_variant.title: Min Variant
min_variant.description: The inclusive minimum of the variant range.

inherit_tamed.title: Inherit Tamed
inherit_tamed.description: If true, the babies will be automatically tamed if its parents are

mutation_factor.title: Mutation Factor
mutation_factor.description:
Determines how likely the babies are to NOT inherit one of their parent's variances. Values are between 0.0 and 1.0, with a higher number meaning more likely to mutate.

Properties:
• color (float) = 0
• extra_variant (float) = 0
• variant (float) = 0

color.title: Color
color.description: The percentage chance of the offspring getting its color as if spawned rather than inheriting color from its parents.

extra_variant.title: Extra Variant
extra_variant.description: The percentage chance of a mutation on the entity's extra variant type.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: The percentage chance of a mutation on the entity's variant type.

offspring_pairs.title: Offspring Pairs

parent_centric_attribute_blending.title: Parent Centric Attribute Blending
parent_centric_attribute_blending.description: List of attributes that should benefit from parent centric attribute blending. For example, horses blend their health, movement, and jump_strength in their offspring.

property_inheritance.title: Property Inheritance

random_extra_variant_mutation_interval.title: Random Extra Variant Mutation Interval
random_extra_variant_mutation_interval.description: Range used to determine random extra variant.

random_variant_mutation_interval.title: Random Variant Mutation Interval
random_variant_mutation_interval.description: Range used to determine random variant.
